title: Download a script, make it executable and run it
threat_model: An attacker with a foothold downloads a second-stage script from a server they control, marks it executable and runs it, each step as a separate command.
notes: The server is python3 -m http.server on 127.0.0.1:18741, started by setup.sh before the pipeline and serving a harmless script. The action runs curl -o, chmod +x and the downloaded file by its absolute path, so the three steps are three execs. The connect is to loopback, which outbound_after_exec skips, and nothing else in the rules applies to this activity, so no alert is listed as acceptable.
